title: ci(scheduled-full-run): a refresh of the hourly red card leaves a stale `pm:blocked` on it, so a new red on main sits ungrabbed until triage notices (06:01Z red, re-queued only at 07:01Z)
body:
**Filing gate ①, with the maintainer's word:** a measured process defect. The maintainer's 「ok」 (2026-10-18, triage seat's chat, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) answers the triage seat's proposal to file it. Filed by the triage seat (#6015). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat, the owner of the hourly-red cards. The logic lives in `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` (`fileOrRefreshCard`), driven by its `--self-test`. The workflow `.github/workflows/scheduled-full-run-card.yml` is governed (Tier H) if it has to change.

## What happened (measured)

- 2026-10-16: #23885 (`hourly full run: red on main (CI)`) was graded `pm:blocked` on #23908 by the triage seat (its 12:46Z note on that card). The `Blocked-by:` line went into a comment, because the hourly run rewrites the body.
- #23908 closed on 2026-10-16. The card kept `pm:blocked`.
- 2026-10-18 06:01Z: the hourly `CI` run went red (`Test Core (4/6)`, `packages/cli`). At 06:30:24Z the workflow refreshed #23885's body. By design it did not touch labels (「Labels are applied on CREATE only」), so the card stayed `pm:blocked`, and no seat takes work from `pm:blocked`.
- The triage seat re-queued it in its 07:01Z round (`6246886169`). Main was already green again at 07:01Z (`53ef752436`), and the 06:01Z failure was never named by a seat in between.

So the report fired, but the card it refreshed was in a state that tells every seat "not yours". The refresh-never-touches-labels rule protects a seat's grade, but a stale `pm:blocked` is not a grade the new red was graded under.

## Wanted (shape is the lane's call; one candidate each)

- **A, narrowest:** on a refresh, if the card carries `pm:blocked` and every `Blocked-by:` target named on the card (body or comments) is closed, swap `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` and say so in the body. Every other label stays untouched.
- **B:** on a refresh while `pm:blocked`, write a line into the refreshed body naming the stale state ("this card is `pm:blocked`; its blocker #N is closed"), and let the unlock scan act on it. Labels untouched.
- ⛔ Not adding a gate. ⛔ The refresh never applies a grade (priority or lane): that stays the seat's.

## Done when

- `--self-test` covers the measured sequence: a blocked card, its blocker closed, a new red, then the refresh. It asserts the chosen outcome, with a control where the blocker is still open and the card stays `pm:blocked`.
- The live refresh path does the same on the next red.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectstack issues were enumerated over REST (543 issues, control #24162 found) and grepped for `scheduled-full-run` / "hourly full run" beside `pm:blocked`, "stale", "blocker" or "label". 3 hits: two seat posts (#20163, #6017) and #24158 (closed, the Rerun Safety nightly red). None is this defect.
